profile.name: S6-40可编程直流电源
profile.description: S6-40是一台实验室用可编程直流电源，可向外部负载提供受控直流电流，并监测输出电流及负载电阻等状态。它常用于器件供电、线圈或加热负载驱动以及一般电学测试。
profile.description_en: The S6-40 is a laboratory programmable DC power supply that delivers controlled DC current to an external load and can monitor quantities such as output current and load resistance. It is commonly used for powering devices, driving coils or resistive loads, and general electrical testing.
